title: Diwali Party 2026
description: Illuminate Your Diwali Night with Bollywood Vibes
long_description:
Illuminate Your Diwali Night with Bollywood Vibes
Mark your calendar for Diwali Party 2026, a night filled with a blend of traditional Indian culture and contemporary entertainment. Taking place on the 6th of November, 2026, this event will be a concoction of dance, live in concert performances, and a delightful assortment of food and drink. Presented by Bollywood Events San Diego, this is an occasion not to be missed. Come, be a part of this vibrant celebration and revel in the spirit of Diwali with us.
CJ Charenjeet: The Man Behind the Melody
Be ready to be captivated by the enchanting performance of CJ Charenjeet, the star artist of the night. With his multi-faceted talent as a singer, performer, composer, songwriter, recording artist, playback singer, and music producer, CJ Charenjeet has always left audiences worldwide spellbound. Immerse yourself in a melodious evening with his charismatic presence and soulful performance.
Royal Banquet: An Exquisite Venue for an Exquisite Night
The event will unfold at the Royal Banquet, located at 8990 Miramar Road, San Diego, CA, United States. Known for its safety and easy accessibility, the location also boasts a variety of nearby attractions. With ample parking space, you can enjoy the event without any hassle. And if you're in the mood for some authentic Indian cuisine before the event, there are several Indian restaurants in the vicinity to satisfy your cravings.
Secure Your Spot: Ticket Information
Make sure you secure your spot at this extraordinary event. We offer a variety of seating options to suit your preference. Children under 18 can enjoy 4th and 5th row open seating for just $40.00. Early bird adults can avail of the same seating arrangement for $65.00. For a closer view of the performance, 3rd and 2nd row adult seats are priced at $80.00 and $85.00 respectively. For those seeking an exclusive experience, VIP front row adult seats are available for $125.00. And if you're coming with a group, grab a front row VIP table for 10 at $1100.00.
